name: OCLTSVM executable operation-contract language
scope: Target-language syntax, static restrictions and execution semantics. This document contains no requirement decomposition, business target selection or repair strategy.

clauses.definition: Optional initialized, explicitly typed bindings. Query-only; result, @pre, object creation and effects are not admitted.
clauses.precondition: A non-mutating Boolean condition evaluated before effects. result, @pre and object creation are not admitted.
clauses.postcondition: Boolean obligations over the post-state, with executable effects as described below. result has the operation's declared return type.

types.modelTypes: Entity names, feature names, enumeration names and literals come from the supplied UML. Enum literals use Type::LITERAL. Service state uses self.name; parameters use their declared names.
types.bindings: Definition and iterator bindings require explicit types. Definition bindings require initializers; iterator bindings cannot have initializers.
types.receivers: isEmpty, notEmpty, size and sum are collection operations, not String operations in this language. String equality and inequality are supported.
types.typeTest: oclIsTypeOf(T) returns a Boolean. It does not statically narrow the receiver to T; subtype-only features require a receiver declared with that subtype.

expressions.logic: and, or and if-then-else-endif. There is no standalone not, implies or xor keyword. Mixed and/or at one nesting level is not admitted.
expressions.navigation: Property receivers are variables or self, not arbitrary query expressions. A standard-operation receiver supports a variable or one property segment, such as self.state; longer chained navigation followed by a standard operation is not admitted by the parser. See the grammar for property and date-call forms.
expressions.iteratorBody: Typed iterators have a logical-formula or if-expression body. A bare true/false literal as an iterator body is not admitted.
expressions.membership: includes, excludes, includesAll and excludesAll accept a bound identifier argument, not an inline query expression.

collections.sumBy: source->sumBy(element:Entity | numericSelector). One typed iterator, a pure Integer/Real selector, numeric branches for conditional selectors. Each distinct source object contributes; equal projected numbers retain multiplicity. Empty source yields zero. Undefined or nonnumeric selector results fail.
collections.projectSet: source->projectSet(element:Entity | objectSelector). One typed iterator, a pure selector returning one defined model object. Result is an identity-deduplicated Set, with no flattening and no target-repository registration requirement. Null, scalar and collection-valued results fail.

execution.assignment: In a postcondition, equality on a mutable attribute or association is an update obligation. result = expression specifies the operation's return value. Other conditions are predicates checked against the resulting state.
execution.creation: An uninitialized typed let object can be created by object.oclIsNew() in the effect path.
execution.membershipEffects: Postcondition includes/excludes on repositories or association collections add/remove membership. Pure checking observes membership without changing it.
execution.forAll: A postcondition forAll body containing effects executes those effects for source elements; pure rechecking evaluates predicates without mutation.
execution.preState: Property @pre references in postconditions read captured pre-operation values. Preconditions and Definitions cannot contain @pre. New objects have no pre-state property snapshot.
execution.time: Declared Today and Now are read-only invocation environment values. Today is the entry calendar day. Date comparisons are isBefore, isAfter and isEqual; After(n)/Before(n) return dates offset by n days.
execution.calls: User-defined operation calls and implicit casts are outside the executable generation subset.
